title: CF7 Pro Suite Attribute & Tag Reference

attributes.data-cf7p-step: Step label string to split the form into a multi-step wizard
attributes.data-cf7p-show-if: Conditional expression using field names and operators (=, !=, *=, >, >=, <, <=, &&, ||)
attributes.data-cf7p-calc: Safe math expression referencing field names, +, -, *, /, (), round(), min(), max()
attributes.data-cf7p-prefix: Prefix string for calculator or range output
attributes.data-cf7p-suffix: Suffix string for calculator or range output
attributes.data-cf7p-decimals: Integer decimal precision for calculator output
attributes.data-cf7p-target-input: Name of CF7 [hidden] field to sync calculated result into
attributes.data-cf7p-whatsapp: Target phone number in international format for post-submit WhatsApp redirect
attributes.data-cf7p-redirect: URL to redirect to on wpcf7mailsent
attributes.data-cf7p-success-modal: Confirmation text shown in an animated overlay on wpcf7mailsent

additionalSettings.cf7p_webhook: URL receiving non-blocking JSON POST on wpcf7_mail_sent
additionalSettings.cf7p_disable_storage: Set to true to disable local cf7p_entry CPT saving
